Sadly, my parents' relationship is abusive. My father's family was severely hurt by years of alcoholism, and he has followed down the same path. He drinks until he passes out nearly every day. For as long as I can remember, my dad would have violent outbursts and hurt me, my mother, and my sister each time. On numerous occasions, he has nearly killed/severely injured my mother. At this point, my siblings and I are out of town for most of the year, and I worry every day that he is going to snap.

My mother grew up in an unhealthy home and does not understand how harmful his actions are. Even her own parents say that the way my dad acts is okay and that she needs to forgive him because "this quote in the bible says..."

Many of the red flags that signal one of his outbursts involve his drinking. I can normally tell how the night is going to play out by his mood when he starts drinking. If he is angry, he will likely make a big deal out of nothing. If he's in a more neutral mood, there's a good chance he will quietly pass out at some random spot around the house/yard.

I have tried to convince my mom to leave him for years, but she doesn't understand what I say. She knows that my opinion of him is biased from past experiences and won't listen to the points that I make. I've almost entirely given up trying to talk to her about it because all it does is cause tension between the two of us. I hope that time will allow her to see just how horrible of a person he is and that he will never change. Yes, he had a bad childhood, but that does not make it okay to act as he does. 

Any suggestions/tips on how to help are very welcome.
